human_check_steps:
# Check: Android letter popup stays at least 200 ms

1. Install the new Android build on a phone (`scripts/build-android-app.sh install`).
2. In any text field, tap letter keys quickly one at a time: each popup is clearly visible (about 0.2 s), no longer a flash.
3. Type fast with two thumbs: each new key's popup replaces the last one at once; nothing lags behind.
4. Hold a key with a corner symbol: the popup turns to the symbol as before; slide off a key: the popup goes at once.
label: implemented
